shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure shown frontally/in profile with headdress
stylized garment or body markings rendered as incised patterned bands
circular/disc motif on the torso area
carved relief detail on a stone surface
justification: Both depict a single dominant humanlike figure with a headdress and incised surface decoration including circular/disc-like motifs on the body, but that is about as far as it goes. A is a blocky, frontal, near-abstract columnar figure with schematic loops and bosses and no visible limbs or attributes, whereas B is a detailed profile figure with two pairs of wings, articulated musculature, fringed robe, beard and hair curls, holding objects and flanked by a stylized floral border — quite different iconographic schemes and conventions.
